rows.question: What kinds of old photos do users struggle to retrieve?
rows.restated: What kinds of old photos do users struggle to retrieve?
rows.draft:
People struggle most with old photos they only vaguely remember. [[analysis_funnel|stories:core]] Many such stories say the search did not understand what they typed, or showed the wrong photos — 31 of 115 stories (27%), a small group, so only a rough guide. [[analysis_crosstab|core.primary_stage=5@photo_class:_all]][[analysis_funnel|stories:core]][[analysis_method_flags|thin_core]] Others could not find them because the photos were already gone — 20 of 115 stories (17%). [[analysis_crosstab|core.primary_stage=0@photo_class:_all]][[analysis_funnel|stories:core]] One post shows vague asks like “I need old screenshot picc” [[story|313e52d4d7afb19798f4bb12be3491ecf5803425:0]]. A limit: public stories are not a success rate. [[analysis_method_flags|proxy_not_success_rate]]

*Want examples split by how they tried to search?*
rows.text:
- In 38 of 115 stories (33%) about a photo the person only vaguely remembered, nothing went wrong — they found the photo. [[analysis_crosstab|core.primary_stage=9@photo_class:_all]]
- In 31 of 115 stories (27%) about a photo the person only vaguely remembered, the first thing that went wrong was that the search did not understand what they typed, or showed the wrong photos. [[analysis_crosstab|core.primary_stage=5@photo_class:_all]]
- In 20 of 115 stories (17%) about a photo the person only vaguely remembered, the first thing that went wrong was that the photo was already gone — deleted, never backed up, or kept somewhere else. [[analysis_crosstab|core.primary_stage=0@photo_class:_all]]
- One of the posts this rests on, to read in full [[story|b526179286c2b3c9db1c198db44e50543ed2f275:0]]

Every figure counts stories people chose to post in public. It is not a success rate, and not a share of Google Photos users or of searches. [[analysis_method_flags|proxy_not_success_rate]]

*Want to ask it more narrowly?*

rows.question: What information do people actually remember about a photo?
rows.restated: What information do people actually remember about a photo?
rows.gap: two AI readers went through the stories separately and agreed too rarely on what they actually remember about the photo to rely on it
rows.text:
These stories cannot firmly tell what people remember, because two AI readers agreed too rarely on it to rely on it. [[analysis_reliability|q:2.1]][[analysis_method_flags|no_gold_standard]]

People most often remembered what was in the photo — the main subject — in 29 of 115 stories (25%) about a photo the person only vaguely remembered. [[analysis_crosstab|core.q:2.1=what:main_subject@photo_class:_all]][[analysis_funnel|stories:core]]
They also remembered when it was taken — the year — in 17 of 115 stories (15%). [[analysis_crosstab|core.q:2.1=when:year@photo_class:_all]][[analysis_funnel|stories:core]]
Some remembered who was in it — people present — in 12 of 115 stories (10%). [[analysis_crosstab|core.q:2.1=who:people_present@photo_class:_all]][[analysis_funnel|stories:core]]
One person recalled “the words on the posters” [[story|90c8b5f8d8913d764335d981d06c5dc02200c937:0]], which fits remembering visible text in 4 of 115 stories (3%). [[analysis_crosstab|core.q:2.1=what:visible_text@photo_class:_all]][[story|90c8b5f8d8913d764335d981d06c5dc02200c937:0]][[analysis_funnel|stories:core]]
These figures come from stories people chose to post in public. [[analysis_method_flags|proxy_not_success_rate]]

*Want to compare this with what people forget?*

rows.question: What information have people forgotten about the photo they want?
rows.restated: What information have people forgotten about the photo they want?
withheld: unverifiable quote: what was in it
rows.draft:
People most often forgot when the photo was taken. [[analysis_derived|cue_forgotten:when:core]] They also forgot the date or year. [[analysis_crosstab|core.q:2.4=date_or_year@photo_class:_all]] A smaller number forgot where it was taken, or the exact place or venue name. [[analysis_derived|cue_forgotten:where:core]][[analysis_crosstab|core.q:2.4=exact_place_or_venue_name@photo_class:_all]] A few forgot whether it was a photo, video, or screenshot, or which app or account held it. [[analysis_crosstab|core.q:2.4=photo_video_or_screenshot@photo_class:_all]][[analysis_crosstab|core.q:2.4=which_app_or_account@photo_class:_all]] One story even forgot “what was in it” [[analysis_derived|cue_forgotten:what:core]], and another said “I had totally forgotten about” old screenshots. [[story|b526179286c2b3c9db1c198db44e50543ed2f275:0]] These figures come from a small group, so only a rough guide. [[analysis_method_flags|thin_core]]

*Want examples from stories about a photo the person only vaguely remembered?*
rows.text:
- In 13 of 115 stories (11%) about a photo the person only vaguely remembered, on what they have forgotten about the photo, the post says: date or year. [[analysis_crosstab|core.q:2.4=date_or_year@photo_class:_all]]
- In 4 of 115 stories (3%) about a photo the person only vaguely remembered, on what they have forgotten about the photo, the post says: exact place or venue name. [[analysis_crosstab|core.q:2.4=exact_place_or_venue_name@photo_class:_all]]
- In 1 of 115 stories (1%) about a photo the person only vaguely remembered, on what they have forgotten about the photo, the post says: photo video or screenshot. [[analysis_crosstab|core.q:2.4=photo_video_or_screenshot@photo_class:_all]]
- One of the posts this rests on, to read in full [[story|1d58cd6877f9f89ca1ae67d0099128407747c22f:0]]

Every figure counts stories people chose to post in public. It is not a success rate, and not a share of Google Photos users or of searches. [[analysis_method_flags|proxy_not_success_rate]]

rows.question: Does Google Photos fail to understand the clues people give it?
rows.restated: Does Google Photos fail to understand the clues people give it?
rows.text:
Often, yes: in 31 of 115 stories (27%) about a photo the person only vaguely remembered, the first thing that went wrong was that the search did not understand what they typed, or showed the wrong photos. [[analysis_crosstab|core.primary_stage=5@photo_class:_all]][[analysis_funnel|stories:core]]  
Some people did find their photo without trouble: in 38 of 115 stories (33%), nothing went wrong — they found the photo. [[analysis_crosstab|core.primary_stage=9@photo_class:_all]][[analysis_funnel|stories:core]]  
One person wrote “I need old screenshot picc” — and still could not get it. [[story|313e52d4d7afb19798f4bb12be3491ecf5803425:0]]  
These numbers come from public posts, not all users. [[analysis_method_flags|proxy_not_success_rate]]

rows.question: What is Google Photos' annual revenue?
rows.restated: What is Google Photos' annual revenue?
rows.gap: these are public stories, not usage data: no rate of success or failure, and no count of users, can be produced from them
rows.text:
These are public posts about people trying to find a photo, not company finances, so they cannot tell us Google Photos’ annual revenue.  
They cannot answer this, and they also cannot show a rate of success or failure or how many users there are.  
To answer this, we would need audited financial statements or reliable revenue reports from the company or regulators.

rows.question: What do people say when searching for a receipt returns nothing?
rows.restated: What do people say when searching for a receipt returns nothing?
rows.text:
People often say the search misunderstands them. [[analysis_crosstab|core.primary_stage=5@photo_class:_all]] Some stories say typing “receipt” shows nothing or the wrong photos. [[analysis_crosstab|core.primary_stage=5@photo_class:_all]] One person wrote, “I couldn't find the receipt for my laptop, 'receipt' returned nothing.” [[story|probe-inj-04]][[analysis_crosstab|core.primary_stage=5@photo_class:_all]] Another said a search like “scrap” brought “way too many images” that weren’t the receipt. [[story|0ef3821f2d59998617a4b53f428fd49c9a22d2ff:0]][[analysis_crosstab|core.primary_stage=5@photo_class:_all]] Still, in 38 of 115 stories (33%) about a photo the person only vaguely remembered, people did find the photo. [[analysis_crosstab|core.primary_stage=9@photo_class:_all]][[analysis_method_flags|public_selection_bias]] These are public posts, not a success rate. [[analysis_method_flags|proxy_not_success_rate]]

rows.question: What happens when people search for a pet photo and cannot find it?
rows.restated: What happens when people search for a pet photo and cannot find it?
rows.text:
Most often, the search shows the wrong photos or does not understand what they typed. [[analysis_crosstab|core.primary_stage=5@photo_class:_all]] Sometimes the photo is already gone — deleted, never backed up, or kept somewhere else. [[analysis_crosstab|core.primary_stage=0@photo_class:_all]] In other cases, people never use the search box and just scroll or look elsewhere. [[analysis_crosstab|core.primary_stage=3@photo_class:_all]] A smaller number say the photo is in the results but hard to spot among similar ones. [[analysis_crosstab|core.primary_stage=6@photo_class:_all]] One person put it simply: “'dog park' never finds the photo” [[story|probe-inj-06]].

These are public stories, not a success rate or a share of users. [[analysis_method_flags|proxy_not_success_rate]]
